reason: B wins both viewports on visual merit: a confident 64px/800 headline with accent colour, live clock/countdown chips, a gradient orb centrepiece, and a 4-cell telemetry strip on a coherent indigo-on-light identity — full-canvas balance (4.7/8.3/2.8% ink across left/mid/right) versus A's narrow centred column of small, generic type with dead side margins (0.6%/0.3%). Mobile is consistent with desktop (orb scales 230→138px, telemetry stacks cleanly with zero overlapping nodes), while A's mobile is a timid text column with ragged intro wrapping. A's merits are content volume (incident cards, uptime tabs), not design; on hierarchy, typography, colour, and showpiece feel B is clearly better.
